notes: Evaluates /cadence-migrate contracts: expand default vs --contract mode, prerequisites (spec schema changes or entity diff + executable tooling), Deep-reasoning xhigh delegation to cadence-migration-author, apply -> rollback -> reapply cycle, deferred contract logging in decisions.md, offload_log_triage, and offload_deep_review.

evals.name: requires-spec-or-schema-diff-and-verifies-rollback
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-migrate BTG-142 for newly added ORM columns in expand mode.
evals.expected_output: Checks spec.md schema section or entity model diff against integration branch and stack tooling, delegates to cadence-migration-author (Deep-reasoning, xhigh effort) separating DDL from DML in expand mode, runs apply -> rollback -> reapply piping noisy logs through offload_log_triage, and executes offload_deep_review on the migration diff.
assertions: Defaults to expand mode separating DDL from DML when --contract is absent
Delegates to cadence-migration-author at Deep-reasoning tier (xhigh effort)
Verifies reversible apply -> rollback -> reapply cycle routing noisy logs via offload_log_triage
Executes offload_deep_review on the generated migration diff before MR creation

evals.name: contract-mode-and-missing-prerequisite-prompt
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-migrate BTG-142 --contract (and separately invoke without spec or schema diffs).
evals.expected_output: Switches to contract mode recording deferred contraction follow-up details in specs/<id>/decisions.md; prompts operator when neither spec.md schema changes nor branch entity diffs exist instead of guessing schema deltas.
assertions: Sets mode to contract when --contract is supplied and records deferred follow-up in decisions.md
Prompts operator instead of guessing when neither spec.md nor entity diffs exist
